'''Star Wing''' was a [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] male, 80 meters in length. His underbelly was silver, while the scales on his back were a pale blue color. Star Wing lived for centuries in [[The Drift/Legends|The Drift]] before deciding to explore other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, the Star Dragon almost suffocated while traversing the Drift due to lack of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Fortunately for the intrepid explorer, Star Wing encountered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and was able to communicate with them its need for oxygen using its latent [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sensitivity. Having gaining sufficient nutrition from them, he continued on his way.

The Duinuogwuin later encountered the same group of Rebels when they were under attack from the [[The Scourge|Scourge Pirates]]. Star Wing was able to return their kindness by attacking the pirates' ''[[Impasse]]'' with a blast of superheated gas from his stomach.
